'''二黒土星'''(じぐろどせい)とは、[[暦]]、[[占い]]に用いられる[[九星]]の一つ。 ==属性== *[[五行]] - 土 *[[八卦]] - 坤(こん) *季節 - [[土用]] *方位 - 南西
==象意== *勤勉、従順、謙遜、古い、遅延 *大衆、庶民、土地、集合、四角

'''二黒土星'''(じぐろどせい)とは、[[暦]]、[[占い]]に用いられる[[九星]]の一つ。 >

revision.text:
{{otheruses|Nine Stars of Divination|Nine Stars in Indian Astronomy|Nine Luminaries}} {{Cite source|date=December 2018}} {{color}} '''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[folk belief]] originating from ancient [[China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.
The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."
== Origin == The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|magic square|ja|魔方陣}}:
{| class="wikitable" |- |Four||Nine||Two |- |Three||Five||Seven |- |Eight||One||Six |}
In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. These numbers are paired with seven colors (white, black, blue, green, yellow, red, and purple), the {{ill|five elements|ja|五行思想}} ({{ill|wood|ja|木}}, {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|earth|ja|土}}, {{ill|metal|ja|金}}, and {{ill|water|ja|水}}), the {{ill|ten heavenly stems|ja|十干}}, the {{ill|twelve earthly branches|ja|十二支}}, and the {{ill|eight trigrams|ja|八卦}} of {{ill|I Ching|ja|易経}}. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."
According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|ja|禹}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Luo Writing|ja|洛書}}), one of the {{ill|River Chart and Luo Writing|ja|河図洛書}}.
== The Nine Stars == In Japanese {{ill|Onmyōdō|ja|陰陽道}}, the following table associates the Nine Stars with the {{ill|five elements|ja|五行思想}}, {{ill|directions|ja|方位}}, {{ill|eight trigrams|ja|八卦}}, and colors, forming the '''Nine Stars Chart''' used to predict {{ill|fortune|ja|運勢}} and the {{ill|auspiciousness|ja|吉凶}} of directions based on a person's birth year.
{| class="wikitable" |- ! Star ! Reading ! Five Element ! Direction ! Eight Trigram ! Color |- ! {{ill|First White Water Star|ja|一白水星}} | Ippaku Suisei | Water | {{ill|North|ja|北}} | {{ill|Kan|ja|坎}} | style="background:white;"| White |- ! {{ill|Second Black Earth Star|ja|二黒土星}} | Jikoku Dosei | Earth | Southwest | {{ill|Kun|ja|坤}} | style="background:black;color:white;"| Black |- ! {{ill|Third Blue Wood Star|ja|三碧木星}} | Sanpeki Mokusei | Wood | {{ill|East|ja|東}} | {{ill|Zhen|ja|震}} | style="background:blue;color:white;"| Blue |- ! {{ill|Fourth Green Wood Star|ja|四緑木星}} | Shiroku Mokusei | Wood | Southeast | {{ill|Xun|ja|巽}} | style="background:green;color:white;"| Green |- ! {{ill|Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星}} | Goō Dosei | Earth | Center | {{ill|Tai Chi|ja|太極}} | style="background:yellow;"| Yellow |- ! {{ill|Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星}} | Roppaku Kinsei | Metal | Northwest | {{ill|Qian|ja|乾}} | style="background:white;"| White |- ! {{ill|Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星}} | Shichiseki Kinsei | Metal | {{ill|West|ja|西}} | {{ill|Dui|ja|兌}} | style="background:red;color:white;"| Red |- ! {{ill|Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星}} | Happaku Dosei | Earth | Northeast | {{ill|Gen|ja|艮}} | style="background:white;"| White |- ! {{ill|Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星}} | Kyūshi Kasei | Fire | {{ill|South|ja|南}} | {{ill|Li|ja|離}} | style="background:purple;color:white;"| Purple |}
Despite their names, the Nine Stars are not related to celestial objects like the planets in the {{ill|Solar System|ja|太陽系}}.
== Relationships Among the Stars == The relationships among the Nine Stars follow the {{ill|five elements theory|ja|五行思想}}:
{| class="wikitable" |- ! Star ! Beneficial (Compatible) ! Neutral (Compatible) ! Harmful (Incompatible) |- ! First White Water Star | Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star, Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star | First White Water Star | Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star |- ! Second Black Earth Star | Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star | Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | First White Water Star, Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star |- ! Third Blue Wood Star | First White Water Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star | Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star | Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star, Eighth White Earth Star |- ! Fourth Green Wood Star | First White Water Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star | Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star | Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star, Eighth White Earth Star |- ! Fifth Yellow Earth Star | Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star | Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | First White Water Star, Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star |- ! Sixth White Metal Star | First White Water Star, Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star | Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star |- ! Seventh Red Metal Star | First White Water Star, Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star | Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star |- ! Eighth White Earth Star | Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star, Ninth Purple Fire Star | Second Black Earth Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | First White Water Star, Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star |- ! Ninth Purple Fire Star | Second Black Earth Star, Third Blue Wood Star, Fourth Green Wood Star, Fifth Yellow Earth Star, Eighth White Earth Star | Ninth Purple Fire Star | First White Water Star, Sixth White Metal Star, Seventh Red Metal Star |}
These relationships are used for predicting {{ill|compatibility|ja|相性}}, {{ill|fortune|ja|運勢}}, and {{ill|auspicious directions|ja|吉方位}}.

{{出典の明記|date=2018年12月}}
{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ 後天定位盤 |- | 四 || 九 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 二 |- | 三 || 五 || 七 |- | 八 || 一 || 六 |}
{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ 二黒が中宮の場合 |- | 一 || 六 || 八 |- | 九 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 二 || 四 |- | 五 || 七 || 三 |}
'''二黒土星'''（じこくどせい）とは、[[暦]]、[[占い]]に用いられる[[九星]]の一つ。
九星では土に属するものには他に五黄土星と八白土星があるが、二黒土星は、土としては平らな土地や[[田畑]]の土を表すという。
==属性== *[[五行思想|五行]] - 土 *[[八卦]] - 坤 *[[十干]] - 戊、己 *[[十二支]] - 未、申 *季節 - [[土用]] *方位 - 南西 *月 - 7月、8月 *時間 - 13時～17時 *数 - 五、十 *色 - 黄色 *味 - 甘味
==象意== *勤勉、従順、謙遜、古い、遅延、地味 *大衆、庶民、土地、集合、四角、布団、甘い物、老婆，母親
==他の星との関係（相性）== *相生 - [[六白金星]]（土生金）、[[七赤金星]]（土生金）、[[九紫火星]]（火生土） *相克 - [[一白水星]]（土剋水）、[[三碧木星]]（木剋土）、[[四緑木星]]（木剋土） *比和 - 二黒土星、[[五黄土星]]、[[八白土星]]
==二黒土星の（中宮になる）年== 西暦年を9で割って割り切れる年が二黒土星の年となる。
‥‥- [[1935年]] - [[1944年]] - [[1953年]] - [[1962年]] - [[1971年]] - [[1980年]] - [[1989年]] - [[1998年]] - [[2007年]] - [[2016年]] - [[2025年]] - [[2034年]] - [[2043年]] - [[2052年]] - [[2061年]] - [[2070年]] - ‥‥
{{DEFAULTSORT:しこくとせい}} [[Category:九星]]

{| class="floatright wikitable" style="text-align:center; font-family:serif;" |+ When Nikoku is in the center |- | 1 || 6 || 8 |- | 9 || style="background-color:#FF80C0; font-weight:bold;" | 2 || 4 |- | 5 || 7 || 3 |}
'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.
== Attributes == * [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]] - {{ill|Earth (wuxing)|ru|Земля (у-син)|comment=doing this to prevent wrong interwiki linking by bot|lt=Earth (土)|4=mn|5=Шороо (махбод)|6=uk|7=Земля (У-сін)|8=als|9=Ärde in dr chinesische Fümf-Elemänt-Leer|10=bcl|11=Daga (wuxing)|12=vi|13=Thổ (Ngũ hành)|qq=}} * [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]] - {{ill|Kūn (Bagua)|ja|坤|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun (坤)|qq=}} * [[:en:Heavenly Stems|Ten Heavenly Stems]] - {{ill|Tsuchinoe (戊)|ja|戊|zh|戊|gan|戊|hak|Vú (thiên-kôn)|ja|Tsuchinoe|simple|User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoe (戊)|vi|Mậu (Thiên can)|za|Fouh (diengan)|zh-min-nan|Bō͘ (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|戊|zh|戊|qq=}}, {{ill|Tsuchinoto (己)|ja|己|zh|己|gan|己|hak|Kí (thiên-kôn)|ja|Tsuchinoto|simple|User:Immanuelle/Tsuchinoto (己)|vi|Kỷ (Thiên can)|za|Geij (diengan)|zh-min-nan|Kí (Thian-kan)|zh-yue|己 (天干)|zh|己 (天干)|qq=}} * [[:en:Earthly Branches|Twelve Earthly Branches]] - [[:en:Goat (zodiac)|Goat (未)]], [[:en:Monkey (zodiac)|Monkey (申)]] * Season - {{ill|Doyō (season)|ja|土用|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Doyō (season)|lt=Doyō}} * Direction - Southwest * Month - July, August * Time - 13:00–17:00 * Number - Five, Ten * Color - Yellow * Taste - Sweet
== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers
== Relationships with Other Stars == * Generating Cycle (相生) - {{ill|Roppaku Kinsei|1=Sixth White Metal Star|ja|六白金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Roppaku Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Sixth White Metal Star|qq=}} (Earth produces Metal), {{ill|Shichiseki Kinsei|1=Seventh Red Metal Star|ja|七赤金星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shichiseki Kinsei|13=User:Immanuelle/Seventh Red Metal Star|qq=}} (Earth produces Metal), {{ill|Kyūshi Kasei|1=Ninth Purple Fire Star|ja|九紫火星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyūshi Kasei|13=User:Immanuelle/Ninth Purple Fire Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyūshi Kasei|13=User:Immanuelle/Ninth Purple Fire Star|qq=}} (Fire produces Earth) * Overcoming Cycle (相克) - {{ill|Ippaku Suisei|ja|一白水星|1=First White Water Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ippaku Suisei|13=User:Immanuelle/First White Water Star|qq=}} (Earth overcomes Water), {{ill|Sanpeki Mokusei|ja|三碧木星|1=Third Blue Wood Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sanpeki Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Third Blue Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood overcomes Earth), {{ill|Shiroku Mokusei|ja|四緑木星|1=Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shiroku Mokusei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fourth Green Wood Star|qq=}} (Wood overcomes Earth) * Harmonious Relationship (比和) - Nikoku Dosei, {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}}, {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in [[:en:Calendar|calendars]] and [[:en:Divination|fortune-telling]].
Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings == * Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity * Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}.

Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

* Time - 13:00–17:00
* Number - Five, Ten
* Color - Yellow
* Taste - Sweet

== Symbolic Meanings ==
* Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity
* Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

== Relationships with Other Stars ==

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}.

Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings ==
* Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity
* Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}.

Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings ==
* Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity
* Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}.

Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

* {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Twelve Earthly Branches}} - {{ill|Goat (zodiac)|en|Goat (zodiac)|WD=Q867696|lt=Goat (未)}}, {{ill|Monkey (zodiac)|en|Monkey (zodiac)|WD=Q740674|lt=Monkey (申)}}
* Season - {{ill|Doyō (season)|ja|土用|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Doyō (season)|lt=Doyō}}
* Direction - Southwest
* Month - July, August
* Time - 13:00–17:00
* Number - Five, Ten
* Color - Yellow
* Taste - Sweet

== Symbolic Meanings ==
* Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity
* Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

== Relationships with Other Stars ==

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}.

Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

* Direction - Southwest
* Month - July, August
* Time - 13:00–17:00
* Number - Five, Ten
* Color - Yellow
* Taste - Sweet

== Symbolic Meanings ==
* Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity
* Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

== Relationships with Other Stars ==

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}.

Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings ==
* Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity
* Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling}}.

Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

== Symbolic Meanings ==
* Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity
* Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}.

Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

* Color - Yellow
* Taste - Sweet

== Symbolic Meanings ==
* Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity
* Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

== Relationships with Other Stars ==

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}.

Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

* Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity
* Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}.

Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

'''Nikoku Dosei''' (二黒土星) is one of the {{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星|1=Nine Stars|2=ja|3=九星|lt=Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nine Stars|qq=}} used in {{ill|Calendar|en|Calendar|WD=Q12132|lt=calendars|1=Calendar}} and {{ill|Divination|en|Divination|WD=Q1043197|lt=fortune-telling|1=Divination}}.

Among the Nine Stars, other Earth-associated stars include {{ill|Goō Dosei|1=Fifth Yellow Earth Star|ja|五黄土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goō Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Fifth Yellow Earth Star|qq=}} and {{ill|Happaku Dosei|1=Eighth White Earth Star|ja|八白土星|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Happaku Dosei|13=User:Immanuelle/Eighth White Earth Star|qq=}}. However, Nikoku Dosei represents flatlands and agricultural soil, in contrast to the destructive and rugged terrain associated with Goō Dosei.

* Diligence, obedience, humility, old age, delays, simplicity
* Masses, common people, land, gatherings, squares, futons, sweets, elderly women, mothers
